spans.s: eri-āyam (SITI), Tamil-Sanskrit; income from fishing in the tank, etc.; amount payable by the owners of the fields irrigated by the tank for its upkeep.
eri-īvu (SITI), Tamil; share in the expenses of the maintenance of the tank.
erikkāḍi (SII 12), tank cess of one kāḍi of paddy per field.
eri-mīn̤-pāṭṭam (SII 12), a tax; income from fish in the tank.
